description: This file defines the Twig Lexer class responsible for tokenizing Twig templates, including handling various states like data, block, variable, string, and interpolation. It includes definitions of regex patterns for lexing syntax elements, manages lexer states, and produces a token stream for further parsing.

classes.name: Twig\Lexer
classes.description: Responsible for tokenizing Twig template source code into a stream of tokens for parsing, managing multiple lexer states, regex patterns for syntax, and handling template constructs like comments, raw data blocks, and expressions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the lexer with an environment and options for tag delimiters and whitespace trimming.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Converts a Source object containing template code into a TokenStream of tokens.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up regex patterns and internal state before tokenization begins.

methods.name: lexData
methods.description: Lexes plain text data outside of Twig tags, handles template text and detects tag starts.

methods.name: lexExpression
methods.description: Lexes expressions inside tags, handling operators, names, numbers, strings, punctuation, and nested constructs.

methods.name: stripcslashes
methods.description: Processes escape sequences within strings, handling special characters, hex, and octal escapes.

methods.name: lexRawData
methods.description: Lexes raw data blocks like {% verbatim %} ... {% endverbatim %}.

methods.name: lexString
methods.description: Lexes string literals, including handling of interpolations.

methods.name: pushToken
methods.description: Adds a token to the token stream, avoiding empty text tokens.

methods.name: moveCursor
methods.description: Advances the cursor position in the source code, updating line number count.

methods.name: getOperatorRegex
methods.description: Generates regex pattern for matching operators based on environment settings.

methods.name: pushState
methods.description: Saves current lexer state and sets a new state.
